after so direct, advise with the agencies  
concerned as to (a) their detailed oper­
ational planning responsibilities respect­
ing such policy, (b) the coordination of  
the interdepartmental aspects of the de­
tailed operational plans developed by  
the agencies to carry out such policy,

changes in the situation. The Board

ports to the National Security Council

erans Preference Act of 1944, as amend­

tive. Order No. 10483 of September 2,  
1953, and provisions amendatory thereof  
contained in other Executive orders (in­
cluding, to the extent that it relates to  
the Operations Coordinating Board pro­
vided for in Executive Order No. 10483,  
the proviso of section 303 (b) of Execu­
tive Order No. 10610 of May 9, 1955).  
Subject to the provisions of this order  
(including the limitations imposed by  
section 3 hereof), the Board may be  
deemed to be a continuation of the Oper­
ations Coordinating Board provided for  
in Executive Order No. 10483, as  
amended.
